name: zn15_33_examine_boundaries_city_border
description: Conformance test 31 (ExamineBoundaries at the city border, §7.3, quirk 5; ZQ5). Named zn15_33 because zn15_30 and zn15_31 already hold two extra SimpleParcellize vectors. City 64 x 64, real mode, SetOptions(0, 1, 0); R is set directly as the restriction region (its rect is its bounding box) and its cells are zoned with the current zone. The grown rect is clamped as the bytes do it: x1' = x1 > 0 ? x1 - 1 : x1, x2' = x2 < cellsX - 1 ? x2 + 1 : x2 (the same for z), so at the border the cell examined is R's own zoned, empty edge cell, which only gets the C = 0 bonus (+1 with placeStreets, nothing without): a border side is neither skipped nor scored as an obstacle. (a) Low edges: R = {x 0..2, z 0..2} without (0, 2), a road (kind 0, bit 0) on (3, 0..2). Side 0 (z1 = 0) examines R's own cells (0..2, 0): 3; side 3 (x1 = 0) examines its own (0, 0) and (0, 1): 2 ((0, 2) is not in R); side 2 examines (1, 3) and (2, 3): 2; side 1 the road on (3, 0..2): 300, C 1. S = {3, 300, 2, 2}, C = {0, 1, 0, 0}, D = 1, Q = 0 (S[0] = 3 > S[2] = 2), flag 1 (skipping the off-map sides would give S[0] = 0 and Q = 2; scoring them as obstacles would give C[0] = C[3] = 2). (c) (a) with SetOptions(0, 0, 0): C starts at 1, no cell gets the +1: S = {0, 300, 0, 0}, C = {1, 1, 1, 1}, D = 1, Q = 2, flag 1. (b) High edges: R = {x 61..63, z 61..63} without (61, 63), a road on (61..63, 60). Side 1 (x2 = 63) examines its own (63, 61..63): 3; side 2 (z2 = 63) its own (62, 63) and (63, 63): 2; side 3 examines (60, 61) and (60, 62): 2; side 0 the road: 300, C 1. S = {300, 3, 2, 2}, C = {1, 0, 0, 0}, D = 0, Q = 1 (S[1] = 3 > S[3] = 2), flag 1. With zone 1 instead the 3 x 3 rect allows the swap (placeStreets, zone 1, wider and deeper than 2): flag 0, D = 1, Q = 0; S and C are computed before the swap and are unchanged.
